reason: Mastermind is a repeatable, instant-speed exit for Demonic Pact and saves engine pieces from removal. Swiftfoot Boots already covers Obeka's protection, so Greaves is redundant.
Strangling Grasp forces a nonland sacrifice every upkeep, and Obeka multiplies that. Bloodsucker's 1-point drain is minor. The deck's removal and sac outlets turn Strangler on easily.
Gisa steals every opposing creature our removal kills, and Obeka's extra upkeeps deploy them repeatedly. Tormentor's punisher choice lets opponents pick the least painful option.
Chimera bounces Pact during upkeep before its fourth mode, a built-in safe exit. It also rebuys Courts, Fugue and Virtue. Prophet is good value but off-role here.
Cloak makes Obeka permanently unblockable and shrouded with no card cost. Key needs a discard each turn and only draws once per untap, so extra upkeeps don't help it.
The engine is mostly enchantments, and Chimes returns all of them at once for three mana. Palace Siege is a fine multiplied upkeep piece but only regrows creatures.
Allure gains a counter in every extra upkeep, steals at instant speed, and scales with the game. Betrayal is a one-shot that takes a while even with faster ticking.
Torch Song gains counters in every Obeka upkeep and becomes a huge burn spell or finisher. Geyser is flexible but needs a large mana investment.
Pact is the plan's removal, draw and give-away finisher, and the list already has exits. Locthwain is strong value but doesn't remove threats or kill.
Fugue is real theft. Each upkeep it grabs the best permanent, and Goblin Bombardment turns that into permanent removal. Embereth is a burn plan, not theft.
Mischief swaps Pact onto an opponent for their best permanent, which enables the Pact kill and is theft too. Vantress copies things but can't donate Pact.
Extra upkeeps stack verse counters fast, and the wipe spares Obeka and black creatures. Blasphemous Act kills our 2/5 commander and stolen creatures.
Recantation is an instant-speed Pact exit that scales with Obeka's upkeeps and bounces multiple threats. Aetherize is narrow defense.
Enslave answers an existing threat permanently and pings each upkeep. Betrayal resolves fast with extra upkeeps but removes nothing.
A one-mana Pact exit at instant speed, while cleave still bounces any permanent. Into the Roil's kicker card is minor.
Drown counters creatures too or kills one, and graveyards fill in this long-game deck. Negate is strictly narrower.
Get Out does both jobs: it counters creature and enchantment threats or bounces Demonic Pact to hand. Arcane Denial can't exit Pact and hands opponents two cards.
Time Twist flickers Pact back as a new object with fresh modes, and saves engine permanents from removal or wipes. Deflecting Swat is free but can't reset Pact.
